secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Remote Supabase project URL (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Needed for the app to connect to its backend.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Supabase project ID (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Needed alongside the URL/key.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable (anon) key (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Used by the frontend client.
